consequence.statement: DestinationRules on the same host with totally different exportTo attributes are no longer merged, which changes how traffic policy resolves for such hosts.
consequence.remediation: Set ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false on the pilot deployment to restore the previous merge behavior.

assertion.statement: Istiod no longer merges DestinationRules for the same host when their exportTo attributes are totally different; setting env var ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE to false in pilot restores the old merging.
